verdict.rationale: Docs show AI drafting capability (e.g., 'Draft a welcome email in Design Studio' via the AI agent/MCP, and 'AI-generated global styles') indicating AI can generate email content, but there's no specific evidence of an in-composer subject-line/copy-refinement feature driven from a brief, distinct from the broader agent/automation-building AI. missing for 10: dedicated documentation or screenshots of subject-line drafting/refinement inside the email composer, independent hands-on confirmation of this specific feature.
